consent.title: Your privacy choices
consent.summary: Optional analytics and advertising services stay off until you choose to allow them. Necessary local storage keeps your choice.
consent.settingsDescription: Choose which optional services this fan hub may load. You can return here and change or withdraw your choice at any time.
consent.necessaryDescription: Always active. Stores your privacy choice locally so we do not ask on every visit.
consent.analyticsDescription: Allows Google Analytics, Microsoft Clarity, and Plausible to measure site usage and help improve guides.
consent.adsDescription: Allows Google AdSense to load advertising after you explicitly opt in and to process page and device data under Google's policies.
